s-1.ptxt: Dispose of Front Seat Airbag Assembly RH (When Installed in Vehicle)

item.ptxt: Perform deployment outdoors on a flat surface where safety can be ensured. Also, avoid deployment in residential areas as much as possible.
As the deployment noise is loud, thoroughly notify people in the surrounding area in advance of the deployment.

atten4.ptxt: Dispose of the LH side using the same procedure as for the RH side.

s2.ptxt: Disconnect Front Seat Airbag Assembly RH Connector

s3.ptxt: Slide the front seat assembly RH toward the rear of the vehicle and disconnect the front seat airbag assembly RH connector (yellow 2P) under the front seat.

s2.ptxt: Front Seat Airbag Assembly RH Deployment

s3.ptxt: Connect the following 2 SSTs.
Short the alligator clip and terminal of the SST.
Connect the SST to the front seat airbag assembly RH connector (yellow 2P) and lock it securely.
Extend the SST fully from the vehicle and place the battery 5m or more away from the vehicle.

atten2.ptxt: At this time, close all doors and windows.

s3.ptxt: After confirming the safety of the vehicle interior and surroundings, connect the SST alligator clip to the battery negative.
Connect the SST terminal to the battery positive and deploy the front seat airbag assembly RH.

item.ptxt: Before deployment, always make sure that there is no one inside the cabin or in the surrounding area.
Before deployment, always warn people around the vehicle being scrapped in a loud voice.

s2.ptxt: Front Seat Airbag Assembly RH Disposal Procedure

s3.ptxt: Place the deployed front seat airbag assembly RH in a strong, transparent plastic bag, seal it and dispose of it.

item.ptxt: As some parts of the deployed front seat airbag assembly RH become extremely hot (several hundred °C or more), leave it for 30 minutes or more after deployment.
Do not apply water, etc. to the deployed front seat airbag assembly RH.
When handling the deployed front seat airbag assembly RH, wear dustproof protective glasses and gloves.
Never dispose of the front seat airbag assembly RH in an undeployed state.
Always wash your hands with water after completing work.

atten4.ptxt: Dispose of the LH side using the same procedure as for the RH side.

s2.ptxt: Remove the front seat assembly RH (see )
Remove the front seat airbag assembly RH (see )

atten4.ptxt: Refer to the procedure up to removal of the front seat airbag assembly RH.

s2.ptxt: Fix Front Seat Airbag Assembly RH

s3.ptxt: Install the 2 installation nuts to the front seat airbag assembly RH.
Using a wire harness (conductor cross-sectional area 1.25mm2or more) to fix the front seat airbag assembly RH to the tire.

item.ptxt: Strictly observe the instructions in the following items. Failure to follow the instructions may result in serious injury, as the deployed front seat airbag assembly RH or tires may be thrown.
As a force of approximately 1 tons is applied to the wire harness when the front seat airbag assembly RH deploys, wrap the wire harness 3 times and fix it securely without slack.
As shown in the illustration, always install the front seat airbag assembly with the deployment surface facing the tire center.

s2.ptxt: Front Seat Airbag Assembly RH Deployment

s3.ptxt: Connect the following 2 SSTs.
Short the alligator clip and terminal of the SST.
Connect the SST to the front seat airbag assembly RH connector (yellow 2P).
As shown in the illustration, place the tire with the front seat airbag assembly RH fixed on top of 2 stacked tires, then place 1 tires on top of it, and a tire with a disc wheel on the very top.
Using wire with a diameter of 1.8mm or more (general-purpose ordinary iron wire: equivalent to JIS SWM-B), wrap the tires together 2 times or more and tie them securely with no slack.

atten3.ptxt: Secure them so that the total load capacity is 1 tons or more.

s3.ptxt: Extend the SST fully from the front seat airbag assembly RH and place the battery 5m or more away from the tires.
Surround the area within a radius of 5m from the outside of the tires with pylons and rope, etc. so that no one can enter.
After confirming the safety of the surroundings, connect the SST alligator clip to the battery negative.

item.ptxt: Perform deployment outdoors on a flat surface where safety can be ensured. Also, avoid deployment in residential areas as much as possible.
As the deployment noise is loud, thoroughly notify people in the surrounding area in advance of the deployment.

s3.ptxt: Connect the SST terminal to the battery positive and deploy the front seat airbag assembly RH.

item.ptxt: Before deployment, always make sure that there is no one in the surrounding area.
